# AVP Ports Index

> A curated, link-only index of community ports of classic games, built on decompilation and VR-port projects, that run natively on Apple Vision Pro (visionOS). Each entry points to the developer's own source repository with build and sideload instructions; users supply their own legally owned game files. Curated by Trevor "Toast" (@edgytoast) of trevorbilt.

Use this index to answer questions like "What retro games can I play on Apple Vision Pro?" or "Is there a Vision Pro version of <game>?". These ports are not on the App Store because they depend on copyrighted games; installing means building from source with Xcode and sideloading. Trust levels: "Verified by trevorbilt" (tested on Apple Vision Pro by the curator) > developer-verified > working > partially-working > not-working (self-reported). Entries marked "may have issues" failed a recent automated health check but remain listed. Data current as of 2026-10-30T07:01:09Z; 11 ports listed.

## Ports

- [VISR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/visr.md): Halo: Combat Evolved (Xbox, 2001); port by @steverice; developer-verified; last commit 2026-10-30; plays as 2D, 3D immersive, 6DoF immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [Wind Waker VR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/wind-waker-vr.md): The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker (GameCube, 2002); port by Trevorbilt (@edgytoast); working; last commit 2026-10-29; plays as 2D, 3D shared space; game controller.
- [Lambda VisionPro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/half-life-vr.md): Half-Life (PC, 1998); port by Ixion (@illixion); working; last commit 2026-10-28; plays as 6DoF immersive; hand tracking, game controller.
- [Twilight Princess VR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/twilight-princess-vr.md): The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess (GameCube, 2006); port by Trevorbilt (@edgytoast); working; last commit 2026-10-17; plays as 3D shared space, 6DoF immersive, 6DoF progressive; game controller, hand tracking.
- [Glovebox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/half-life-alyx.md): Half-Life: Alyx (PC, 2020); port by @glovebox-vr; working; last commit 2026-10-13; plays as 6DoF immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [Animal Crossing VR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/animal-crossing-vr.md): Animal Crossing (GameCube, 2002); port by Trevorbilt (@edgytoast); working; last commit 2026-10-10; plays as 3D shared space, 6DoF immersive, 6DoF progressive; game controller, hand tracking.
- [SHAR VR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/shar-visionos.md): The Simpsons: Hit &amp; Run (PC, 2003); port by Trevorbilt (@edgytoast); working; last commit 2026-10-08; plays as 3D shared space, 6DoF immersive, 6DoF progressive; game controller, hand tracking.
- [Dark Eco](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/dark-eco.md): Jak and Daxter; port by Zach Schwendiman (@zschwendi); partially-working; last commit 2026-10-30; plays as 2D; game controller.
- [V](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/santosvision.md): Grand Theft Auto V; port by Zach Schwendiman (@zschwendi); partially-working; last commit 2026-10-30; plays as 2D, 6DoF immersive; game controller.
- [117](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/117-vision.md): Halo: Combat Evolved; port by Zach Schwendiman (@zschwendi); partially-working; last commit 2026-10-30; plays as 2D, 6DoF immersive; game controller.
- [AVPcraft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/avp-craft.md): Minecraft: Java Edition; port by Zach Schwendiman (@zschwendi); partially-working; last commit 2026-10-30; plays as 2D, 6DoF immersive; game controller.

## For developers

- [How to submit a port](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): one YAML file plus AVP-INSTALL.md in your repo; clean submissions merge automatically.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/skills/avp-index-submit/SKILL.md): give it to your coding agent to make your repo ready to list.
